task.title: Add a CSV export of orders
task.description: Add a CSV export of orders: a toCsv(orders) function in src/export.js, with a test. Customer names can contain commas.

analyst.summary: Add a CSV export of the shop's orders, as a toCsv(orders) function with a test.
requirements: src/export.js exports toCsv(orders), which returns the orders as CSV text.
The first row names the columns.
A customer name with a comma in it stays in one column.
assumptions: The export is built in memory; the orders list is small.
risks: Names with commas or quotes break a naive CSV.

questions.question: Which columns should the CSV have?
questions.why: The task does not say, and it changes what the file holds.
options: Order id, customer, total and date

analyst.summary: Add a CSV export of the shop's orders with the columns id, customer, total and placedAt, as a toCsv(orders) function with a test.
requirements: src/export.js exports toCsv(orders), which returns the orders as CSV text.
The columns are id, customer, total and placedAt, named in the first row.
A customer name with a comma in it stays in one column.

planner.summary: Add toCsv(orders) in src/export.js, one row per order under a header row, and cover it with tests.

flow.detail: It returns a header row, then one row per order.

flow.step: Download it from the orders page
